Government Scheme Offers Loans and Subsidies for Farmers

A government scheme, referred to as the 'Krishak Samriddhi Yojana' by one report, is offering long-term loans of up to ₹6 lakh to small and marginal farmers for agricultural investments. The annual interest rate is set at 6%, with an additional 5% subsidy available on the interest for timely repayment of installments. Another report mentions a 'Mukhyamantri Khet Suraksha Yojana' which provides up to 60% subsidy for solar fencing.
